title: Research My Accounts
summary: Start from a list of target companies: answer five questions, approve one maximum price, and your agent returns a card per company saying whether to contact it now, why, with dated sources, and whom.
outcome: Paste companies; learn which to contact now, why (with dated sources) and whom.
boundary: It researches the companies you give it; to find new companies, use Find Leads. It does not send email, add anyone to your CRM, guess addresses or spend more than the maximum you approve. A reason to reach out now is a timing signal, not proof that a company will buy.

catalog_tools.purpose: Find a company's website when only its name is given.
Industry, staff count, location and description for fit and deal-breakers.
News from the last 90 days, dated and linked, for why now.
Read one page when the agent cannot read it itself or the site blocks the agent's reader.
People step 1: list 10 people at the company (20 above 50 staff) with their titles; the agent picks the best title match.
People step 2: search by job title, with the work email and source pages, only when the staff list has no match.
People step 3: one person by job title, only while the provider answers, in place of step 2 when Hunter is unavailable.
Confirm a person's current role when the newest evidence is over a year old or sources disagree.
Work email for the chosen person from the staff list or Findymail, from their profile URL or name and company domain.
Second email lookup, used once when the first finds nothing.
Check each email the same day it is found: verified, catch-all or not ready.

inputs: What you sell, in one sentence
The companies: paste names or websites, or attach a CSV

Who buys: job titles (default set by the kind and size of company and shown in the plan: Managing Partner, Partner, Director or Owner at accountants, law firms, agencies and consultancies; Owner or Founder up to 10 staff; Founder or CEO up to 50; the Head or VP of the relevant team above that)
Deal-breakers that rule a company out (default: none)
How many to research (default 10, in your order)
outputs: A summary line such as "4 of 10 ready · 3 not yet · 3 skipped · $0.82 · 8 min"
One card per company: Contact now, Not yet or Skip; why now with its date and link; why it fits with a link; who to contact with email status and date checked; and an opening question
A CSV with the Find Leads columns plus why now, its date and link, and the verdict
What could not be finished, with a priced retry, and a priced offer for the rest of your list
Details at the end: the sources checked and every paid call with its run ID and cost

cost.model: You approve one maximum and pay only for calls that complete. Per company: a website lookup when only a name is given, company data (reused from a same-day Find Leads hand-off), one news search and one paid page read in case a site blocks the agent's reader, then a staff list, a title search only when the list has no match, up to three email lookups, a role check when needed and one email check. Companies skipped early are replaced from your list, up to twice the number asked for. Refused calls are not charged.
cost.notes: Prices inspected 14 Oct 2026: website lookup $0.0025; company data $0.0067; news search $0.0025; page read $0.0033; LeadMagic staff list $0.0175 for 10 people, $0.035 for 20; Hunter title search $0.0335 for up to 10 people (billed per 10 results; $0.335 is the listed price for 100); Findymail title search $0.0278 per person; role check $0.0098; email lookup $0.0068, second lookup $0.035; email check $0.0025. One company costs at most $0.1444 and a replacement $0.015. Maximum: 5 companies $0.80, 10 companies $1.60 from a longer list or $1.45 from a list of exactly 10; add $0.0033 per company when the agent cannot read web pages itself ($0.83 for the 5-company trial, $1.66 and $1.48). Companies handed over by Find Leads the same day cost far less: 7 cost at most $0.05. The Skill inspects prices again before every quote.

approvals: Approve one maximum price before the first paid call
Approve again before anything that would go over it, including retries and the next batch from your list
Nothing is sent and nothing is added to your CRM
compatibility: One Scrollport connection that can search, inspect and run tools and read the wallet
Optional: web page reading in the host, which saves a paid page read per company
Somewhere to save the CSV and a small progress file
